Nvidia has reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as its chief executive on November 23, 2026, less than two weeks after he stepped down amid allegations linked to a suspected Chinese espionage scandal. The board said consultations with senior U.S. government officials helped clear national security concerns. The decision follows U.S. President Donald Trump's public support for Huang's return, while an independent investigation continues.
Thank you for watching our video!
